parametrized_description: A brewery can ferment their product into either wine or kombucha. Each unit of wine requires FruitWine units of fruit and WaterWine units of water. Each unit of kombucha requires FruitKombucha units of fruit and TeaKombucha units of tea. The company has available WaterAvailable units of water and TeaAvailable units of tea. Wine sells for more, therefore the number of wine must be larger than the number of kombucha. Additionally, at least MinKombuchaProp of their products made must be kombucha. How many of each should the brewery make to minimize the total units of fruit required?

FruitPerWine.description: Units of fruit needed for one unit of wine

WaterPerWine.description: Units of water needed for one unit of wine

FruitPerKombucha.description: Units of fruit needed for one unit of kombucha

TeaPerKombucha.description: Units of tea needed for one unit of kombucha

MinKombuchaPercentage.description: Minimum percentage of products made that must be kombucha

NumWine.description: Number of units of wine to produce

NumKombucha.description: Number of units of kombucha to produce

constraints.description: Units of wine produced is non-negative
Units of kombucha produced is non-negative
Total water used for wine production must not exceed TotalWater
Total tea used for kombucha production must not exceed TotalTea
The number of wine units must be larger than the number of kombucha units
At least MinKombuchaPercentage of total products must be kombucha

objective.description: Minimize the total units of fruit required
